title: Points of Interest (Areas)
description: OSM ways and relations tagged amenity, shop, tourism, leisure, office or healthcare, as polygons: schools, parks, malls, hospitals, parking lots and similar. Cut to the admin regions (states, provinces and territories) of Canada, Mexico and the United States, one GeoParquet file per region. This collection reads the nightly build, so its contents change every night. Read every region at once with the partition glob s3://parquetry/osm/latest/country=*/state=*/amenities_polygons.parquet through the anonymous S3 endpoint s3.geomermaids.com (path-style, empty credentials), or one region over plain HTTPS. The README gives both setups.

providers.name: OpenStreetMap contributors
providers.description: Created and maintain the data, published under the ODbL 1.0.

providers.name: Geofabrik GmbH

providers.name: Geomermaids
providers.description: Converts the extracts to GeoParquet nightly, and maintains and hosts this catalog and its data.

partition:keys.name: state
partition:keys.description: ISO 3166-2 code of the admin region (state, province or territory), e.g. US-NY. One file per region.

table:columns.name: osm_id
table:columns.description: OSM element id. Unique only together with osm_type, since nodes, ways and relations have separate id spaces. An area carries the id of the way or relation it was built from. A feature crossing a region border appears once per region it touches.

table:columns.name: osm_type
table:columns.description: OSM element type: node, way or relation.

table:columns.name: country
table:columns.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code. Same value as the country= partition key.

table:columns.name: state_name
table:columns.description: Name of the admin region (state, province or territory) the file was cut to.

table:columns.name: state_iso
table:columns.description: ISO 3166-2 code of the admin region, e.g. US-NY or CA-ON. Same value as the state= partition key.

table:columns.name: amenity
table:columns.description: Value of the OSM amenity tag as text; NULL when absent. See https://wiki.openstreetmap.org/wiki/Key:amenity

table:columns.name: tags
table:columns.description: Every OSM tag on the element, as a key to value map. The promoted columns are typed copies of single tags.

table:columns.name: bbox
table:columns.type: STRUCT(xmin FLOAT, ymin FLOAT, xmax FLOAT, ymax FLOAT)
table:columns.description: Per-feature bounding box in float32, rounded outward so it always contains the geometry (at most about 9 m of slack). Declared as the GeoParquet `covering` for the geometry column, and its Parquet min/max statistics let any engine skip row groups: filter on bbox.xmin/ymin/xmax/ymax before touching geometry.

table:columns.name: geometry
table:columns.description: Feature geometry, native Parquet GEOMETRY (GeoParquet 2.0), OGC:CRS84 longitude/latitude. Geometry types: MultiPolygon.
